model_classes.definition: Repeat the target player's observed origin XY for all 15 future samples; output zero displacement for the displacement target.

Fit an unweighted per-coordinate least-squares line to all finite target-player XY observations among the six history samples at offsets -1.0 through 0.0 seconds; extrapolate at 0.2 through 3.0 seconds. If fewer than two distinct-time samples are finite, use origin persistence. Convert predictions to origin-relative displacement by subtracting origin XY.

architecture.history_player_encoder: shared across both teams and players: Linear(78,32), ReLU, Linear(32,16), ReLU; mean-pool encoded player tracks separately by team
architecture.future_opponent_encoder: Linear(45,32), ReLU, Linear(32,16), ReLU; encode and mean-pool every opponent track observed during the 15-sample horizon, including substitutes
architecture.prediction_head: Linear(input_dim,128), ReLU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(128,128), ReLU, Dropout(0.1), Linear(128,30)
architecture.output: 15 future XY pairs in metres; absolute coordinates or per-player origin-relative displacement as named by the cell
architecture.coordinates: finite XY in metres; missing pairs are filled with (0,0) and accompanied by a zero presence mask; no pitch normalization
architecture.identities: provider IDs are used only to group and order tracks; IDs are never numeric features or joined across matches
architecture.time_features: 26 fixed history offsets [-5.0,-4.8,...,0.0] seconds and home=+1/away=-1

training.batch_sampling: with replacement: uniformly sample a fit-role match, then uniformly sample an eligible window with at least one scoreable directed scene, then uniformly sample one scoreable directed scene; each scene loss is its mean Euclidean error over all finite target/time pairs
training.loss: masked physical XY ADE in metres; use the locked origin-target truth mask only
training.determinism: CPU only; seed Python, NumPy, and PyTorch; deterministic algorithms enabled; one intra-op and one inter-op thread; disable backend benchmarking

selection.metric: equal mean of the four validation-match physical XY ADE values in metres
selection.checkpoint_tie_break: earliest step; strict numeric inequality is an improvement

compute_budget.worker: one x86_64 CPU core, 16 GiB memory, CPU-only
compute_budget.overrun_policy: stop at the first per-fit or campaign ceiling; never extend after observing a result

retry_only_for: external worker interruption before atomic output commit

execution_order: verify the frozen protocol, this plan, the runtime fingerprint, and the restricted population authority before opening any scoring path
run each deterministic baseline on validation windows in model-class, target, regime, then canonical match order
fit final-role learned cells in target, regime, seed order using the 12 protocol training matches
fit LOMO cells in protocol fold, target, regime, seed order; the held-out match is never used for selection
atomically freeze all 234 learned checkpoint manifests and verify the complete cell/seed/fold set
score all 12 deterministic baseline cells and all learned LOMO/evaluation outputs once; use the protected population gate before every score
write per-match result manifests, then descriptive aggregates and the four preregistered contrasts
stopping_rules: stop a fit at 10 consecutive non-improving validation checks, 5000 optimizer steps, or its compute ceiling, whichever comes first
stop the campaign at 312 CPU-core-hours or 336 wall-clock hours
a missing learned cell, seed, fold, evaluation match, or population identity leaves the campaign incomplete; do not drop it or report the four-match mean
no added cells, seeds, retries, steps, features, or budget after any model or evaluation result is observed

contrast_reporting.seed_aggregation: average the three seed ADE values within each match before contrasts
contrast_reporting.summary: report all four match-level control-minus-context values and their equal-match mean only when all four pairs are scoreable
contrast_reporting.positive_means: lower ADE with added realized context
contrast_reporting.inferential_claims: none; no p-values, confidence intervals, multiplicity adjustment, or significance claims

population_authority.artifact_storage: restricted authorized runtime storage; never commit the artifact, row-level identities, truth hashes, or payload rows
population_authority.match_roles: all 20 matches and the exact protocol role assignment
population_authority.coverage: all candidate origins enumerated in canonical sample order; retain every and only window accepted by the pinned eligibility policy
population_authority.score_gate: exact ordered window, origin, home/away player IDs, target truth digest, target truth-mask digest, role, and population digest equality
population_authority.missing_or_invalid_authority: fail closed before training, validation selection, LOMO scoring, or evaluation scoring

truth_identity_contract.absolute_xy_truth_sha256: representation-tagged absolute physical XY metre panel
truth_identity_contract.displacement_truth_sha256: representation-tagged per-player origin-relative displacement metre panel
truth_identity_contract.qualification: The protected population qualification blocker must independently verify both sealed panels describe identical physical truth using observed nonzero per-player origin XY; masks and ordered membership must be identical
truth_identity_contract.scorer_binding: output target_representation must equal the exact frozen cell; validation uses all four validation matches, LOMO uses exactly the protocol fold held-out training match, evaluation uses all four evaluation matches

field_types.plan_and_protocol_hashes: the exact plan/protocol IDs, versions and SHA-256 values in this authority
field_types.run_id_cell_id_model_class_id: nonempty strings; cell_id and model_class_id must match one frozen matrix row
field_types.information_regime_target_representation: one frozen regime and target value from the matrix cell
field_types.lomo_fold_id_held_out_match_id: protocol fold identity and held-out training match for lomo; null otherwise
field_types.seed: one frozen integer seed for learned fits; null for deterministic baselines
field_types.train_match_ids_validation_match_ids: ordered protocol training matches for final fits, all except held-out for LOMO, empty for baseline; validation always exact protocol validation matches
field_types.checkpoint_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 for a learned checkpoint; null for a deterministic baseline or failed fit
field_types.selected_step: completed learned checkpoint: multiple of 100 from 100 through 5000; null for baseline or unsuccessful result
field_types.output_artifacts: unique artifact IDs, lowercase SHA-256, output or diagnostic relation
field_types.metrics: array of match-scoped ADE/FDE/XY-RMSE finite values with metres as unit
field_types.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical manifest fields excluding manifest_sha256

result_manifest_schema.semantic_validator: evaluation_population.validate_prospective_result_document; mandatory before consuming any result; JSON Schema alone is insufficient

completed_metric_scopes.final_train: all four validation and all four evaluation matches
completed_metric_scopes.lomo: all four validation matches and exactly the fold held-out match
completed_metric_scopes.baseline: all four validation, all four evaluation, and all twelve training matches as descriptive LOMO controls

result_manifest_schema.unsuccessful_results: no metrics, checkpoint or selected step; output/diagnostic artifacts may record failures
